_about: All the text of SETTINGS' help, ABOUT -> FEATURES and ABOUT -> CREDITS (P21, 2026-11-14). Upper case and the original font's characters only; lines are wrapped by the engine. Each feature: name (as listed), setting (the SETTINGS item it belongs to, or empty when always on; then label and values, in the order the engine numbers them), help (green, SETTINGS and the FEATURES list), note (cyan, SETTINGS only: default and the original), and its FEATURES page: what, keys, default, original.

features.name: AUTOMAP
features.label: AUTOMAP
features.help: A MAP OF EVERY SQUARE THE PARTY HAS STOOD ON. WALKING: M MINI-MAP, F FULL MAP.
features.note: DEFAULT: ON. OFF: AS THE ORIGINAL, WHICH HAS ONLY ITS OWN AREA VIEW.
features.what: A MAP OF EVERY SQUARE THE PARTY HAS STOOD ON, WITH ITS WALLS AND DOORS; THE PARTY IS AN ARROW. KEPT WITH THE QUICK SAVE.
features.keys: WALKING: M MINI-MAP, F FULL MAP, ESC CLOSES THE FULL MAP.
features.original: NO AUTOMAP. ITS OWN AREA VIEW IS STILL THERE, UNCHANGED.

features.name: QUICK SAVE
features.help: F2 SAVES THE GAME AT ONCE WHILE WALKING, F3 LOADS IT; CONTINUE ON THE START MENU TOO. ALWAYS ON.
features.what: ONE SAVE YOU CAN MAKE AT ANY TIME WHILE WALKING, APART FROM THE ORIGINAL'S OWN SAVES.
features.keys: WALKING: F2 SAVES, F3 LOADS. START MENU: CONTINUE LOADS IT.
features.original: SAVES ONLY FROM ENCAMP (SAVE), IN SLOTS A TO J. THOSE ARE STILL THERE, AND LOAD SAVED GAME READS THEM.

features.name: BATTLE ENDS WHEN WON
features.help: A FIGHT ENDS THE MOMENT EVERY ENEMY IS DEAD OR GONE. ALWAYS ON.
features.what: A FIGHT ENDS THE MOMENT EVERY ENEMY IS DEAD OR GONE. WITH SOME ONLY DOWN, THE ROUND PLAYS OUT AND CONTINUE BATTLE IS ASKED, AS IN THE ORIGINAL.
features.original: PLAYS OUT THE REST OF THE ROUND FIRST.

features.name: PORTRAITS MATCHED
features.label: PORTRAITS
features.help: NEW CHARACTERS START ON A HEAD AND BODY THAT FIT THEIR RACE, SEX AND CLASS.
features.note: DEFAULT: MATCHED. ORIGINAL: EVERY NEW CHARACTER STARTS ON THE FIRST HEAD AND BODY.
features.what: WHEN A CHARACTER IS CREATED, ITS PORTRAIT STARTS ON A HEAD AND BODY THAT FIT ITS RACE, SEX AND CLASS. YOU CAN STILL CHANGE IT.
features.original: EVERY NEW CHARACTER STARTS ON THE FIRST HEAD AND BODY.

features.name: START MEMORIZED
features.label: START MEMORIZED
features.help: CASTERS PICK THEIR SPELLS AT BEGIN ADVENTURING, MEMORIZED AT ONCE, NO REST NEEDED.
features.note: DEFAULT: ON. OFF: AS THE ORIGINAL, NOTHING MEMORIZED UNTIL A REST.
features.what: WHEN A NEW PARTY BEGINS ADVENTURING, EACH CASTER PICKS ITS SPELLS AND HAS THEM MEMORIZED AT ONCE.
features.original: NOTHING IS MEMORIZED AT THE START; THE PARTY RESTS IN CAMP TO MEMORIZE.

features.name: QUICK BANDAGES
features.label: QUICK BANDAGES
features.help: A QUICK FIGHTER BANDAGES A DYING ALLY FIRST, AS A PLAYER WOULD.
features.note: DEFAULT: OFF, AS THE ORIGINAL: ITS QUICK NEVER BANDAGES.
features.what: A PARTY MEMBER ON QUICK BANDAGES A DYING ALLY BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE, AS A PLAYER WOULD FROM THE DONE MENU.

features.name: MAGIC ON DONE
features.label: DONE MENU MAGIC
features.help: DONE'S MENU SHOWS MAGIC:ON OR MAGIC:OFF: WHETHER QUICK CHARACTERS CAST SPELLS. CHOOSE IT TO SWITCH.
features.note: DEFAULT: ON. THE ORIGINAL HAS ONLY ALT-M, WHICH STILL WORKS.
features.what: DONE'S MENU GAINS A MAGIC ITEM AFTER SPEED. IT SHOWS WHETHER QUICK CHARACTERS MAY CAST SPELLS AND SWITCHES IT, AS ALT-M DOES. EACH FIGHT STILL STARTS WITH MAGIC OFF, AS THE ORIGINAL.
features.keys: DONE, THEN MAGIC. ALT-M STILL WORKS AT THE COMBAT MENU AND DURING A COMPUTER TURN.
features.original: ONLY ALT-M (THE REFERENCE CARD), WHICH SAYS MAGIC ON OR MAGIC OFF ON THE BOTTOM LINE AS IT SWITCHES.

features.name: TACTICS FOR QUICK
features.label: TACTICS FOR QUICK
features.help: SMARTER: QUICK HEALS, AIMS AT THE WEAKEST, SAVES ITS SPELLS AND FLEES A HOPELESS FIGHT.
features.note: DEFAULT: ORIGINAL, AS THE ORIGINAL'S QUICK.
features.what: SMARTER: THE PARTY'S QUICK MEMBERS BANDAGE AND HEAL, WASTE NO SPELLS, GO FOR THE WEAKEST ENEMY, KEEP OUT OF REACH WHEN BADLY HURT, AND THE PARTY FLEES A HOPELESS FIGHT.
features.original: QUICK PICKS TARGETS AND SPELLS AT RANDOM AND NEVER HEALS.

features.name: ORDERS
features.help: WITH TACTICS FOR QUICK SMARTER, VIEW HAS ORDER: FREE, NO SPELLS, MELEE, STAND OR HEAL.
features.what: A STANDING ORDER FOR EACH CHARACTER ON QUICK: FREE, NO SPELLS, MELEE ONLY, STAND (NEVER MOVES) OR HEAL (HEALS FIRST, NO ATTACK SPELLS).
features.default: FREE. ONLY THERE WHEN TACTICS FOR QUICK IS SMARTER.

features.name: MONSTER TACTICS
features.label: MONSTER TACTICS
features.help: HOW HARD FIGHTS ARE. SMARTER: MONSTERS HEAL, SPARE THEIR OWN SIDE, GO FOR CASTERS.
features.what: A DIFFICULTY OPTION. SMARTER: MONSTERS HEAL, PLACE AREA SPELLS TO SPARE THEIR OWN SIDE, AND GO FOR SPELLCASTERS, THEN THE WEAKEST.
features.original: MONSTERS PICK TARGETS AND SPELLS AT RANDOM.

features.name: FULL SCREEN
features.label: FULL SCREEN
features.help: THE GAME FILLS THE SCREEN, KEEPING ITS SHAPE AND SHARP PIXELS. ALT+ENTER OR F11 SWITCHES IT ANYWHERE.
features.note: DEFAULT: OFF (A WINDOW). THE ORIGINAL RAN FULL SCREEN UNDER DOS; DOSBOX SWITCHES WITH ALT+ENTER.
features.what: THE GAME FILLS THE SCREEN. THE PICTURE KEEPS ITS SHAPE, WITH BLACK BARS AT THE SIDES OR TOP AND BOTTOM, AND ITS PIXELS STAY SHARP. THE CHOICE IS REMEMBERED.
features.keys: ALT+ENTER OR F11, ON ANY SCREEN. SETTINGS: F.
features.original: A DOS GAME, FULL SCREEN BY NATURE; UNDER DOSBOX ALT+ENTER SWITCHES IT. THE GAME ITSELF READS NEITHER KEY.
